description_en: Obtains the organizational units (OUs) of an Active Directory (AD) domain that is connected to an enterprise AD office network (formerly workspace)
description_zh: 获取AD办公网络（原工作区）对接的AD域的组织单元OU信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd list-user-ad-organization-units --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-4853610000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserAdOrganizationUnits

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The enterprise AD office network ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The string that you enter for fuzzy search
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next request exists. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh:
返回的最大数。取值范围：1~500。
默认值：500
parameters.name: max_results

OUNames.description_en: The OUs of the AD domain

items.description_en: The name of the OU in the AD domain

OUName.description_en: The canonical name (CNAME) of the OU in the AD domain controller

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The enterprise AD office network ID
